coverage.member: FusionNumericTextBox(this InputBoundField<TModel, TProp> setup, Action<NumericTextBoxBuilder> build)
coverage.catches: the FusionNumericTextBox builder stops rendering the field bound to the model value (the test asserts the plan opens showing 7.00 meals and 2.00 wellness check-ins carried over from last month, and the summary reads 7)
the Changed event arg contract stops delivering the change payload into the plan, so typing a new meal count updates neither the field nor the visible summary
Value stops carrying the newly entered number (the test types 10 and asserts the summary reads 10)
the Changed event stops firing the reactive handler when the coordinator commits a typed value on blur, so the summary never updates
the .Reactive wiring stops connecting the field's change event to its plan pipeline, so committing a typed value runs no reaction
PreviousValue stops carrying the value before the change (the test lowers the carried-over 7 to 5 and asserts the previous note reads 7)
IsInteracted stops reporting true for a value the coordinator typed, so a typed entry is no longer marked 'You entered this number of meals.'

coverage.member: SetValue(this ComponentRef<FusionNumericTextBox, TModel> self, decimal value)
coverage.catches: SetValue stops writing the standard plan's count onto the field (the test clicks Apply the standard plan and asserts the field and summary both become 14)
Increment stops raising the value by one step (the test clicks Add a meal and asserts meals go from 7 to 8)
Decrement stops lowering the value by one step (the test clicks Remove a meal and asserts meals go from 7 to 6)

coverage.member: SetMin(this ComponentRef<FusionNumericTextBox, TModel> self, decimal min)
coverage.catches: SetMin stops lowering the field's minimum (the test proves 3 clamps to the floor of 4 before, then after SetMin(2) the same 3 sticks at 3)
the Focus event arg contract stops being delivered, so focusing the wellness field runs no reaction and the guidance never appears
the Focus event stops firing when the wellness field gains focus, so the nurse-visit guidance never replaces the prompt
the Blur event arg contract stops being delivered, so leaving the wellness field runs no reaction and the guidance never tidies
the Blur event stops firing when the wellness field loses focus, so the guidance never changes to the saved-state note
FocusIn stops moving the cursor into the wellness field (the test clicks Start entering wellness check-ins and asserts the field becomes focused and its Focus-driven guidance appears)
FocusOut stops taking the cursor out of the wellness field (the test clicks Done with wellness check-ins and asserts the field is no longer focused and its Blur-driven note appears)
the Value source stops yielding the current meal count into the gather body (the test asserts the POST carries "mealsPerWeek":12)

acceptedFanout.reason: one user gesture (typing a meal count and committing it on blur) with DISTINCT fails-when-broken assertions per member: the field value becoming 10.00 and the summary reading 10 (FusionNumericTextBoxChangeArgs.Value), the summary updating at all (Changed firing the handler / Reactive wiring connecting it), and the payload being delivered (FusionNumericTextBoxChangeArgs). The four members share this one commit gesture because Syncfusion emits a single change event on blur; each member is still asserted, not assumed.
